grouping_rule: issue_id = 'ISS-' + topic for every completed record whose intent is complaint or cancellation; one issue per review

issues.name: Accounts hacked, disabled, or deleted without recovery
issues.description: Users lose access to their accounts, whether through hacking, unexplained disabling, or deletion, and support either fails to respond or offers no way to recover the account or premium subscription.

issues.name: Playback controls broken after recent updates
issues.description: Reviewers report that after the update they cannot pause, skip, repeat, or shuffle songs, cannot view lyrics, and cannot manage playlists, making the app unusable.

issues.name: Music playback stops, crashes, or fails to load
issues.description: Reviewers report the app crashing, freezing, or cutting off audio during playback, including after an update, when the phone locks, with Bluetooth headphones, or when playlists will not load.

issues.name: Downloaded songs unexpectedly deleted from library
issues.description: Several reviewers report that downloaded songs and playlists vanish without warning, often after restarts, updates, or storage changes, with no clear cause.

issues.name: Music library content disappearing or missing features
issues.description: The examples share a theme of catalog and content problems, where songs vanish, search or add-to-playlist fails, features like lyrics, Canvas, or Sessions don't appear, shared links show nothing, and audiobooks are misclassified as music.

issues.name: Charged after cancelling or without consent
issues.description: Customers are being billed for premium subscriptions they cancelled, opted out of, never used, or were never clearly told about, and report difficulty stopping the charges or getting refunds.

issues.name: Unreachable human support for account billing problems
issues.description: Reviewers across these examples say they cannot reach a live person to resolve account issues such as overcharges, duplicate billing, stolen accounts, or lost library access, and describe support as bots, unhelpful, or rude.

issues.name: App fails to launch or work
issues.description: Most examples report that the app does not work or crashes on launch, often after an update, with one showing a runtime exception and one mentioning car stereo connection after an update.
